description: Lightweight SolidJS-like frontend framework: fine-grained reactivity without a virtual DOM, MVVM with async dependency injection, Stage-3 class-field decorators, a Rust/SWC JSX compiler, a Vite plugin, SSR and per-node hydration.
rules: Install the runtime with @ivlev-dev/silent-core (or the @ivlev-dev/silent meta package) and the compiler with @ivlev-dev/silent-vite; the Vite plugin alone does not include the runtime.
Configure Vite with silent() from @ivlev-dev/silent-vite and set tsconfig jsx to react-jsx with jsxImportSource @ivlev-dev/silent-core.
Every view component receives its ViewModel through a this-parameter: function Counter(this: { vm: CounterVM; preloader: typeof CounterPreloader }, props: { count: number }).
The ViewModel must be imported with import type; the compiler reads the this-type to build silent.view metadata. Never pass vm explicitly: use <Counter count={3} />.
Define ViewModel fields with Stage-3 decorators on accessor fields: @reactive accessor count = 0, @computed get double(), and @watch on methods. Do not enable experimentalDecorators.

Dependency injection is constructor-based: declare dependencies as constructor parameters, import interfaces with import type, and let the compiler resolve the single implementation. Use bind() when an interface has several implementations.
resolve() is always asynchronous and returns a Promise; use createScope() for request-scoped instances and dispose() for cleanup.
Use For for keyed lists (DOM follows values), Index for position-keyed lists (DOM follows positions), Show, Switch/Match, ErrorBoundary and Suspense for conditional and async rendering.
For SSR, render with renderToString or renderToStream from @ivlev-dev/silent-server, put RenderResult.head into <head>, and hydrate on the client with hydrate() using the same props.
In Vite SSR builds keep the runtime external via ssr.external: @ivlev-dev/silent-core, @ivlev-dev/silent-di, @ivlev-dev/silent-reactivity, @ivlev-dev/silent-server.
Render <title>, <meta> and <link> from any component; the runtime hoists them into <head> (and into RenderResult.head during SSR). Elements with itemprop and content inside <svg> are not hoisted.
Requires Node.js >= 22, Vite >= 8, TypeScript 7 and ESM (type: module). Packages are ESM-only.
